ACT STP Demos

These are versions of the HTML demos presented at my poster. Each one is a single, self-contained file: you can try it right here with preview, or download it and open it in any web browser, no internet connection or installation needed. Feel free to use and adapt them for your own teaching. All were created using Claude, and are designed for classroom or personal work, not for research purposes. If you find any major issues, please reach out :)
